descriptions.inProgress: May was right. When you went into the City Center, you found another survivor, Bao. Bao could not move an inch because he was so afraid of Iruvatas and asked that you help him. He appears to be a big guy, but really, he's just a softie inside.
descriptions.completed: You defeated Iruvatas that were scaring Bao. Bao thanked you for your help. What a softie.
